categories.main_business_segments: Grand Pharmaceutical Group Limited operates primarily in three major areas: nuclear medicine anti-tumor diagnosis and treatment, cerebro-cardiovascular precision interventional diagnosis and treatment technology, and pharmaceutical technology and biotechnology. The pharmaceutical technology segment includes respiratory and critical diseases, ENT, and cerebro-cardiovascular emergency products. The biotechnology segment focuses on amino acids and related products.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced technologies such as radionuclide-drug conjugates (RDCs), radiopharmaceuticals, synthetic biology for amino acid production, mRNA technology platforms, and innovative medical devices including drug-coated balloons and intravascular dual-mode imaging systems. Manufacturing includes modernized production bases with green and intelligent production systems, and proprietary patented technologies in enzyme engineering, fermentation, and liposomal nanoparticle delivery.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Grand Pharma serves hospitals, primary medical and healthcare institutions, pharmacies, and patients primarily in China, with expanding global reach. Key markets include oncology, cardiovascular, respiratory, ophthalmology, ENT, and critical care sectors. The company targets unmet clinical needs and provides advanced treatment solutions for diseases such as liver cancer, prostate cancer, sepsis, allergic rhinitis, dry eye syndrome, and cerebro-cardiovascular emergencies.
categories.geographic_coverage: The Group's operations are mainly in Mainland China and Hong Kong, with significant revenue derived from these regions. It also has international presence and revenue from America, Europe, Australia, and other parts of Asia. The company has subsidiaries and R&D centers in the United States, Australia, Germany, Singapore, and other countries, supporting global clinical trials and commercialization.
categories.supply_chain_position: Grand Pharmaceutical operates across the pharmaceutical supply chain, including upstream raw material production (pharmaceutical raw materials and amino acids), midstream manufacturing of pharmaceutical products and medical devices, and downstream sales and commercialization. It integrates R&D, production, regulatory approvals, and marketing, forming a comprehensive industrial chain from raw materials to finished pharmaceutical and medical products.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The Group emphasizes innovation-driven development with a dual strategy of independent R&D and global expansion. R&D focuses on nuclear medicine, radiopharmaceuticals, cerebro-cardiovascular precision intervention, pharmaceutical technology (including respiratory, ENT, and ophthalmology), mRNA therapeutics, and biotechnology. It invests heavily in clinical trials, technology platforms, and strategic partnerships to address unmet clinical needs and accelerate commercialization of innovative products.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through the manufacture and sales of pharmaceutical technology products, biotechnology products, and nuclear medicine and cerebro-cardiovascular precision interventional products. Sales are recognized at a point in time upon delivery and acceptance by customers. The company also benefits from licensing agreements, strategic collaborations, and acquisitions that expand its product portfolio and market reach.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Grand Pharmaceutical is positioned as a leading innovative pharmaceutical company in China with a strong global presence in nuclear medicine and radiopharmaceuticals. It competes in specialized segments such as oncology, cardiovascular intervention, respiratory and ophthalmic drugs, and biotechnology. The company distinguishes itself through its comprehensive product pipeline, advanced technology platforms, and strategic acquisitions, maintaining competitive advantages in innovation and market coverage.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the year ended 2024, the Group reported revenue of approximately HK$11.64 billion, representing a 10.6% year-on-year increase, and a profit attributable to owners of about HK$2.47 billion, up 31.3%. The company has shown steady growth in revenue and profitability over recent years, with significant increases in nuclear medicine and cerebro-cardiovascular segments. Total assets reached nearly HK$25 billion with net assets of HK$16.53 billion, reflecting a solid financial scale and growth trajectory.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Grand Pharmaceutical offers advanced, innovative treatment solutions addressing unmet clinical needs with a focus on integrated oncology diagnosis and treatment, precision cardiovascular interventions, and specialized pharmaceutical technologies. Its unique value lies in its global leadership in radiopharmaceuticals, proprietary patented technologies, comprehensive product pipelines across multiple therapeutic areas, and strong commercialization capabilities supported by extensive sales networks and strategic partnerships.
